summary: Birks Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its voluntary delisting from NYSE American, effective around August 27, 2026, after being non-compliant with continued listing standards under Sections 1003(a)(i) and (ii). The company’s Class A voting shares will move to the OTCQB Venture Market the day after delisting. Birks will file Form 25 on August 17, 2026, with the last trading day expected on or about August 27. The delisting follows a strategic review of options; no financial terms or advisor were disclosed. The company will continue SEC filings and semiannual reporting. Watch for liquidity and trading dynamics on the OTCQB post-delisting.
